_comment: The client's tests are node's own runner rather than one Stryker has a plugin for, so the command runner is the only option - and it has no per-test coverage analysis, meaning it reruns the whole command for every single mutant. scripts/mutation-tests.sh is that command; set STRYKER_TESTS to narrow a run to the tests that could kill the mutants being made.
_ignoreComment: Stryker copies the project into a sandbox before mutating it. This one contains a Tauri app, so src-tauri/target is 9 GB of Rust build artifacts and src-tauri/gen another 1.2 GB - copying them made a run of any size take minutes per mutant, whatever it was mutating. None of it is reachable from the client's tests.
